{
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "s1",
      "agent_id": "researcher",
      "description": "Research the first home battery technology (e.g., Lithium Iron Phosphate) regarding market share, cost, and efficiency.",
      "dependencies": [],
      "produces": "battery_one_research.md",
      "consumes": [],
      "rationale": "Gather market data for the first technology.",
      "needs_tools": [
        "web_search"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "s2",
      "agent_id": "researcher",
      "description": "Research the second home battery technology (e.g., Solid-State or Flow batteries) regarding market share, cost, and efficiency.",
      "dependencies": [],
      "produces": "battery_two_research.md",
      "consumes": [],
      "rationale": "Gather market data for the second technology in parallel.",
      "needs_tools": [
        "web_search"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "s3",
      "agent_id": "orchestrator",
      "kind": "meeting",
      "attendees": [
        "researcher",
        "creative"
      ],
      "description": "Discuss the research findings for both competing home battery technologies as a team and agree on key comparison metrics.",
      "dependencies": [
        "s1",
        "s2"
      ],
      "produces": "team_discussion_summary.md",
      "consumes": [
        "battery_one_research.md",
        "battery_two_research.md"
      ],
      "rationale": "Reconcile findings and align on approach before writing the report.",
      "needs_tools": []
    },
    {
      "id": "s4",
      "agent_id": "creative",
      "description": "Write the final comparison report based on the research and team discussion.",
      "dependencies": [
        "s3"
      ],
      "produces": "battery_comparison_report.md",
      "consumes": [
        "battery_one_research.md",
        "battery_two_research.md",
        "team_discussion_summary.md"
      ],
      "rationale": "Produce the final markdown report.",
      "needs_tools": []
    }
  ]
}
